about: Daggerfall's RMB town blocks as data: every block of the freeware BLOCKS.BSA, its building and prop placements, ground tiles and flat counts. Overlook holds no reader of Daggerfall's files; this table is the blocks.

frame.block: A block is 102.4 m square (4096 Daggerfall units at 0.025 m).
frame.x: metres east of the block's west edge
frame.y: metres south of the block's north edge
frame.z: metres up from the block's ground
frame.yaw: degrees clockwise from north, turning a model's +z (its north, in content/forged's model frame: x right, y up, z forward) towards east
frame.model: A model's origin stands at (x, y, z); content/forged keeps Daggerfall's model origins.

buildings: [modelId, x, y, z, yaw, buildingType, record]: one row per model of a building record; models of one building share its record (0-based, the block building record that keys its interior and name).
props: [modelId, x, y, z, yaw, scale]: the block's scene models. z includes Daggerfall Unity's props offset (4 units, 0.1 m down) as DFO stands them; scale is 1 in every block.
ground: Base64 of 256 bytes, the 16 x 16 ground tiles of 6.4 m, row by row from the north-west tile: row r spans y 6.4r to 6.4(r+1), column c spans x 6.4c to 6.4(c+1). A byte is record | rotated << 6 | flipped << 7. Records: 0 water, 1 dirt, 2 grass, 3 stone; 4-55 the climate atlas's edges and corners between them; 56-63 random-ground markers, drawn as grass (record 2). The ground plane stands 0.025 m under z 0.

buildingTypes.21: House5 (graves, crypts, a palace grounds piece: not a residence)
buildingTypes.22: House6 (castle and other lone pieces: not a residence)
buildingTypes.note: House1-House4 are residences. Shop, guild, temple, tavern and palace types are named buildings with an interior.

flatKinds.nature: trees, bushes and rocks: archives 500-511, drawn in the climate nature archive, and the ground scenery grid
flatKinds.animals: archive 201: horses, dogs and other animals
flatKinds.lights: archive 210: lamps and torches, each with its point light
flatKinds.markers: archive 199: start and quest markers, never drawn
flatKinds.other: every other archive: barrels, crates, troughs and other decoration
flatKinds.note: Flats are sprites and do not come over as models; these are counts only.
